Select molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles
Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_records.molregno
Join compound_records to docs on compound_records.doc_id = docs.doc_id
Left Join compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno
Filter docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1150213'
Return rows ordered by molecule_chembl_id
Do not apply DISTINCT
